Gartner: Global IT spending to grow by 13.5% this year
news_headlines.summary: Gartner forecasts global IT spending to reach $6.31 trillion this year, a 13.5% increase from 2025, primarily driven by investments in AI. The data center systems segment is expected to see the fastest growth at 55.8%, while IT services will remain the largest spending category exceeding $1.87 trillion. Software, especially generative AI, also shows strong growth, with device market growth slowing due to rising memory prices.

This achievement highlights Esquire Bank's growing merchant services platform and its significant contribution to the company's financial performance.

news_headlines.title: Kyndryl, Google Cloud target AI workloads with local data control
news_headlines.summary: Kyndryl has expanded its Distributed Cloud services with Google Cloud to help enterprises modernize Kubernetes-based applications and run cloud-native workloads across various environments. This collaboration is designed to preserve data sovereignty, meet regulatory and latency requirements, and support AI-driven workloads by maintaining local control over data residency and governance. The partnership aims to accelerate application modernization and improve cost efficiency for AI and data intensive workloads.

news_headlines.title: XBP Global taps HR veteran to shape 10,600-person AI workforce

Her role focuses on aligning talent, leadership, and culture for an AI-first enterprise, leveraging her 20+ years of experience for XBP Global's ~10,600 employees in 20 countries. The appointment underscores XBP Global's commitment to organizational readiness and human accountability in an AI-driven environment.

news_headlines.title: Las Vegas police lock in 5 more years of VR officer training

This renewal ensures continued hardware and software support, access to an expanding scenario library, and on-site training in Q2 2026 to enhance de-escalation and decision-making skills. The market reacted positively to the news, with WRAP stock gaining 8.05%, reflecting increased institutional adoption of its non-lethal and training platforms.
